title: Pure Gishki
summary: Pure Gishki WATER Ritual build with generic staples. By pairing Gishki Grimness, Abyss, Shadow, and Vision with recycling Ritual Spells, the deck repeatedly summons Level 6 to 10 Evigishki Rituals without running out of Tributes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gishki Grimness Special Summons another Gishki monster from the Deck when Normal or Special Summoned (locking your attacks that turn to Ritual Monsters) and can pay the entire Tribute requirement for any WATER Ritual Monster alone.
Gishki Abyss searches any Gishki monster with 1000 or less DEF (including Grimness, Shadow, Vision, or Evigishki Neremanas) on Normal, Flip, or Special Summon, with no once-per-turn limit.
Gishki Shadow and Gishki Vision discard themselves to search any Gishki Ritual Spell or Gishki Ritual Monster respectively, and each counts as the entire Tribute for a WATER Ritual Summon.
Focused Aquamirror searches any Gishki monster from the Deck, then banishes itself from the GY in the End Phase to Set an Aquamirror Spell or Trap from your Deck or GY.

summary.title: Opening: Gishki Grimness or Focused Aquamirror
steps: Normal Summon Gishki Grimness (or search it with Focused Aquamirror) and use its effect to Special Summon Gishki Abyss from the Deck.
Trigger Gishki Abyss to search Gishki Shadow (or Gishki Vision), and discard it to add Gishki Aquamirror (or Gishki Nekromirror) and Evigishki Neremanas.
Activate Gishki Aquamirror, tributing Grimness on the field as the full Level 10 Tribute to Ritual Summon Evigishki Neremanas.

On Ritual Summon, Neremanas revives Gishki Abyss from the GY, which triggers again to search another Gishki Vision or Gishki Vanity; shuffle Gishki Aquamirror from the GY into the Deck to add Neremanas or another Ritual back if needed.

summary.title: Aquamirror Recursion & Nekromirror
summary.text: Gishki Aquamirror has no once-per-turn limit: while in the GY, it shuffles itself back into the Deck to return 1 Gishki Ritual Monster from your GY to your hand, resetting your Ritual engine every turn. Gishki Nekromirror can Ritual Summon a Gishki Ritual Monster by Tributing 1 face-up monster the opponent controls (paying LP equal to the summoned monster's original ATK), breaking boards through destruction protection. Gishki Vanity discards itself so the opponent cannot activate Spells, Traps, or monster effects when you activate a Gishki Ritual Spell or Ritual Summon a Gishki monster.

summary.title: Ritual Bosses & Control
points: Evigishki Neremanas (3000 ATK) revives a WATER monster from your GY on Ritual Summon and cannot be destroyed by battle with Extra Deck monsters; once per turn, when the opponent activates a monster effect, it returns a Gishki Ritual Monster you control (including itself) to the hand to negate that activation and shuffle it into the Deck.
Evigishki Gustkraken looks at up to 2 random cards in the opponent's hand on Ritual Summon and shuffles 1 of them into the Deck.

Evigishki Soul Ogre discards a Gishki monster once per turn to shuffle a face-up card the opponent controls into the Deck, while Evigishki Mind Augus shuffles up to 5 cards from either GY into the Deck on Ritual Summon.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Spright, Herald, Nephthys, and Hieratic hybrid packages are omitted to keep this list pure Gishki.
